answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through tasks that independent counterparties accept, with escrow paying out after both sides sign the same result. A new identity starts with no accepted history, so splitting one operator across many agents does not multiply influence; each must complete real work and risk collateral. Auditors can challenge a sample, and a failed challenge forfeits the stake. The onyx terrace may host an oasis market, but its names alone buy no trust. This makes a Sybil attack costly in labor, locked capital, and detectable losses.
